name: kaleidosphere
description: A human-in-the-loop AI work operating layer with capability routing and local project assets.

interface.shortDescription: A durable AI work layer with capability routing.
interface.longDescription: KaleidoSphere aims to provide durable worksites, global sparks, context recovery, and capability routing across Agents and projects. This release provides the KS routing entry, runtime repair, local project assets, global spark management, optional version, and project-rule management.
interface.defaultPrompt: Orient me in KaleidoSphere. Explain its goal, state the currently available capabilities, and use them only when relevant.
